faq.q1: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a1: No. It runs in the cloud from your computer or phone browser. You just log in with your username and password.
faq.a2: Yes. Each studio’s information is kept separate and protected, with daily backups. You own your data and can export it whenever you want. The audio files in your deliveries are private and shared through links that expire.
faq.q3: Can I add my logo and my prices?
faq.a3: Of course. You set up your name, logo and service catalog; proposals and receipts go out with your studio’s branding.
faq.a4: Try the demo to get a feel for it and subscribe to activate your account. We’ll help with the initial setup and loading your first data.
final.h2: Get your studio in order this week.
final.p: Explore the demo with sample data, or try FoldBack free for 14 days with your own studio’s data.

faq.q5: Can I cancel whenever I want?
faq.a5: Yes. There’s no lock-in: cancel whenever you want and keep access until the end of the period you paid for. Before you leave, you can export all of your data.
faq.q6: How do I pay, and how do I get my receipt?
faq.a6: By card. Every payment generates an automatic receipt that’s emailed to you.
pain.p: Everyday situations in a studio, and how FoldBack handles them.
pain.1q: It’s 11 p.m. and you’re still answering messages to book a session.
pain.1a: Your clients request a session from your booking page; you just confirm.
pain.2q: Two bands showed up at the same room at the same time.
pain.2a: Overlap warnings before you confirm a session.
pain.3q: A client says they already paid and you can’t find where you wrote it down.
pain.3a: Every payment is recorded on the session and in your finances.
pain.4q: Putting together a quote takes you an entire afternoon.
pain.4a: A proposal from a template, with your branding, ready in minutes.
pain.5q: They ask which is the latest version of the mix and you have five different files.
pain.5a: Private-link deliveries, comments on the audio and client approval.
pain.6q: At the end of the month you don’t know if you made money or lost it.
pain.6a: Income, expenses and profit for the month, always up to date.
flow.h2: What a session looks like with FoldBack.
flow.p: From booking to the final payment, every step in one place.
flow.1p: Your clients book from your page, or you schedule the session and assign the room and engineer, and FoldBack warns you if anything overlaps. You send the quote with your branding.
flow.2p: See on a timeline what’s happening in each room today and what’s next. One click to remind the client on WhatsApp.
flow.3p: You deliver mixes and masters with a private link. The client comments on the audio and approves the final version.
flow.4p: You log the payment or send the balance reminder. By the end of the month, income, expenses and profit are already done.
res.h2: Your clients book on their own.
res.p: Every studio gets its own booking page. Clients pick the service, room, day and an open time slot; you just confirm.
res.i1: Only open time slots are offered, within your studio hours and with no clashes with other sessions.
res.i2: Every request holds its spot on the calendar as a pending session.
res.i3: You confirm or decline with one click, and the client gets an email.
res.i4: You decide the services, rooms, duration and lead time, and you can embed the page on your own website.
res.alt1: FoldBack online booking page with the studio’s link and pending requests, with buttons to confirm, decline or message on WhatsApp
res.alt2: The studio’s booking page on a phone: the client picks the service, room, duration and engineer
faq.q7: Can my clients book on their own?
faq.a7: Yes. Every studio gets a booking page with its own link: the client picks a service, room, day and an open time slot, and leaves their details. The request holds the slot on your calendar as a pending session, and you confirm or decline it with one click; the client gets an email.
faq.q8: What happens to the price once the founder spots run out?
faq.a8: The first 30 studios keep their founder price for as long as they stay subscribed, no matter how much it rises later. Once those spots are filled, new studios will pay the regular price, which will be higher.
more.p: What happens around every session has its place too: your clients, your team and the day-to-day running of the studio.
more.g1.i1d: A private page, no account or password: their upcoming sessions, what they have paid and owe, their packages, deliveries and proposals.
more.g1.i2d: Sell hours up front; when you schedule, choose “Pay with package” and they are deducted automatically.
more.g1.i3d: For every set number of session hours, your client earns free hours that you hand over as a package.
more.g1.i4d: The day after the session, the client answers a short survey. If they rate you well, we ask for a Google review; if they rate you low, we let you know.
more.g1.i5d: Note down anyone who asks about prices or dates, move them through stages and turn them into a client when they book.
more.g1.i6d: When a day is full, your booking page offers to join the list; if a slot opens up, everyone on it gets an email.
more.g2.i1d: Invite your people by email and choose their role: owner, admin, engineer, front desk or accountant. Each role sees only what it needs: engineers see no money, front desk sees no finances or salaries, and accountants do not see the schedule.
more.g2.i2d: A filter shows each engineer only their own sessions, in the list and on the calendar.
more.g2.i3d: A report with each engineer’s work.
more.g2.i4d: If you run more than one studio, switch between them from the menu with the same account.
more.g2.i5d: Add FoldBack to your home screen and get alerts for bookings and comments, plus a summary of your day every morning.
more.g3.i1t: Rates by room, time and engineer
more.g3.i1d: The rate is worked out automatically, with a breakdown, when you schedule and in online booking.
more.g3.i2d: Weekly, every two weeks or monthly, with a warning if any date clashes with another session.
more.g3.i3d: Block a room, even every week, and leave time between sessions in online booking.
more.g3.i4d: The client asks for several days in a single request.
more.g3.i5d: Charge for equipment rented by the hour together with the session, also from online booking.
more.g3.i6d: Keep track of the consumables that run out and any damage to equipment.
more.g3.i7d: Subscribe to the studio calendar, or each team member’s, in Google, iPhone or Outlook.
more.g3.i8d: The client answers what you ask before they arrive: songs, players, references.
more.g3.i9d: A reminder 24 hours before and, if the session changes or is cancelled, a notice to the client.
pain.7q: A client pays for ten hours up front and you keep count in a notebook.
pain.7a: Hour packages that are deducted automatically when you schedule.
pain.8q: You want your engineer to see their schedule, but not your finances.
pain.8a: Everyone signs in with a role; engineers see their sessions and no amounts.
faq.q9: Can I give my team access?
faq.a9: Yes. You invite each person by email and choose their role: owner, admin, engineer, front desk or accountant. Each role sees only what it needs: engineers see no money (and can see only their own sessions), front desk sees no finances or salaries, and accountants do not see the schedule.
faq.q10: Can my clients see their sessions and payments?
faq.a10: Yes. Every client has a portal: a private page with their upcoming sessions, what they have paid and owe, their hour packages, deliveries and proposals. They need no account or password; you just send them the link. Your client can switch the language of the page.
faq.a11: FoldBack opens in your browser, and you can add it to the home screen of your iPhone or Android to use it like an app and get alerts for bookings, comments and your daily summary. There is nothing to download from an app store.
more.g1.i7d: Your client drags over the audio waveform to comment on an exact section of the song and picks a color; you see their comments too.
more.g2.i6d: If your studio has more than one place, each location gets its own schedule, rooms, hours and booking link, and Reports compares them.
more.g3.i10d: Send whoever owes you their statement with a button or every month; the session reminder includes their balance.
price.trial: 14 days free for new studios. We ask for a card when you start, but nothing is charged during the trial: if you cancel before it ends, you pay nothing.
faq.q12: How does the free trial work?
faq.a12: When you subscribe you get 14 days to use FoldBack with your own studio’s data. We ask for a card when you start, but nothing is charged during the trial. If you do not cancel before it ends, the first charge is made that day and the subscription renews on its own. You can cancel any time from Settings → Subscription. The trial is only for new studios.
